    """Compare strategies within same pool_size bins to control for pool size confound.

                "R@5_ci": [ci_r5[1], ci_r5[2]],

                "MRR_ci": [ci_mrr[1], ci_mrr[2]],

        # Within-bin deltas (controlled for pool size)
        rand_m = analysis[pool_bin].get("random", {})
        for other in ["embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:

            delta_key = f"{other}_vs_random"
            if rand_m and other_m:
                for metric in ["R@1", "R@5", "MRR"]:
                    rv = rand_m.get(metric, 0)
                    ov = other_m.get(metric, 0)
                    analysis[pool_bin].setdefault(delta_key, {})[f"{metric}_delta"] = ov - rv
                    analysis[pool_bin][delta_key][f"{metric}_rel_pct"] = (
                        (ov - rv) / rv * 100 if rv > 0 else 0.0
                    )

    # Aggregate controlled delta: count-weighted average of within-bin deltas
    for other in ["embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:

        analysis[f"aggregate_{delta_key}"] = {
            "R@1_weighted_delta": weighted_delta / total_n if total_n > 0 else 0.0,
            "total_n": total_n,
        }

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   This is Loop #9 of a Research Reviewer session for the `structfuse-context` project. The reviewer is an independent scientific auditor that:
   - Monitors running experiments on server bjb1-42106 (2× RTX PRO 6000 96GB, cuda:0 and cuda:1)
   - Verifies experiment conclusions against actual data using only read-only tools
   - Reports findings to Director via `reviewer_post_to_director` (only output channel)
   - Reviews worker task completions for correctness
   - Enforces GPU whitelist (cuda:0, cuda:1 only), checkpoint integrity, and disk safety
   
   The session received 8 sequential `worker_done` notifications and reviewed each one, plus one progress monitoring pass. All responses are in Chinese per session instructions.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **LoRA contrastive training**: PEFT LoRA (r=16, q_proj/v_proj) on Qwen2.5-Coder-3B and StarCoder2-3B
   - **Negative mining strategies**: random, embedding_distance, dataflow_aware, bm25 — compared via R@1/R@5/MRR
   - **Stratified analysis**: 5+2 dimensions (repo_size, pool_size, similarity, dataflow, neg_difficulty + pool_size_controlled + dataflow×pool_size cross)
   - **Dry-run mock predictions**: Simulated R@1 values used for pipeline validation, explicitly NOT real model outputs
   - **Confound analysis**: Rich-dataflow instances concentrated in large repos (99.3%); pool_size identified as true confound (R@1 ≈ 1-exp(-5/pool))
   - **Adapter-only checkpoints**: 5.8GB→~200MB, loaded with strict=False
   - **L2-normalized embeddings**: contrastive_model.py line 130 `F.normalize(pooled, p=2, dim=-1)`, making dot product = cosine similarity
   - **Dual checkpoint strategy**: best_by_val_loss and best_by_recall_at_1 saved independently
   - **BM25 watcher processes**: Automatic chaining — watchers monitor training chain PIDs, start BM25 training when M2 chains complete
   - **M1 reextract v2**: Recovering 28,276 failed CodeQL extraction instances, 4 CPU workers parallel
   - **PEP 456 hash randomization**: Caused v1→v2 stratified analysis numerical differences (mock predictions are hash-dependent)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `/root/structfuse/evaluation/analyze_stratified.py` (1308 lines, most recently modified)
     - Central file for stratified evaluation of M2 strategies
     - Three modes: `--dry-run` (mock), `--predictions-dir`, `--checkpoints-dir` (new)
     - `reeval_checkpoint` (line 161+): Batch encoding with batch_size=64, _batch_encode helper, proper L2-norm dot product ranking
     - `run_pool_size_controlled_analysis` (line 484+): Within-bin delta + count-weighted aggregate to control pool_size confound
     - `run_dataflow_pool_cross_analysis` (line 558+): Cross-tabulation with min_cell_size=30 underpowered flagging
     - Adaptive sim bins (line 1201+): `np.percentile([0, 33.3, 66.7, 100])` terciles for non-dry-run mode, overrides SIMILARITY_BINS
     - Config output records `similarity_bin_edges`, `batch_size`, `dry_run` flags

   - `/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/stratified_dryrun_v2/` (stratified_results.json, stratified_summary.csv, stratified_plots.pdf)
     - v2 dry-run output with 5 dimensions, 2980 val samples (seed 42)
     - All R@1 values are mock predictions — CANNOT be cited in paper
     - Consistent ranking: dataflow > embedding > random across all strata

   - `/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/confound_analysis/` (confound_report.md, controlled_comparison.csv, cross_tabulation.csv)
     - Cross-tabulation confirms 99.3% of rich-dataflow in large/xlarge repos
     - Controlled comparison: rich < moderate R@1 persists in 3/3 bins (medium/large/xlarge)
     - Effect sizes small in large/xlarge (~2pp), large in medium but only 99 samples
     - Explicitly states: "R@1 values are from dry-run mock predictions (not real model)"

   - `/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/bm25_overlap_stratified.json`
     - BM25 overlap by repo size: small 88%, medium 68%, large 28%
     - BM25 provides genuinely different negatives only in large repos

   - `/root/structfuse/training/contrastive_model.py` (194 lines)
     - Line 130: `return F.normalize(pooled, p=2, dim=-1)` — L2 normalization confirmed
     - Line 117: `def encode(self, input_ids, attention_mask)` — shared encoder

   - `/root/runs/m2_full_qwen/random_s44.log`
     - eval@500: val_loss=0.4252, R@1=0.6009, R@5=0.9583 (anomalously high)
     - Last seen at step 850, loss=0.2837

   - `/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder/random_s43.log`
     - eval@500: val_loss=0.5279, R@1=0.4708, R@5=0.9469
     - Last seen at step 600, loss=0.5706

   - `/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder/s43plus_all.log`
     - Shows first StarCoder s43 attempt killed (PID 442120), resume script correctly replaced it

   - Literature map: `/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_5/projects/structfuse-context/literature_map.yaml`
     - 37 entries across categories: code retrieval for bug fixing, hard negative mining, contrastive learning for code, etc.

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **ssh_read_only pipe character blocking**: Multiple grep commands with `|` were blocked by security policy. Fixed by using separate grep calls without pipes.
   - **Registry filter by exp_id**: `filters={"exp_id": "plan_005_stratified"}` returned 0 results. The filter syntax may require exact field matching; used limit-based queries instead.
   - **Qwen s43 best_R1 misrecording**: Worker recorded 0.5501 (final eval) instead of 0.5554 (best checkpoint at step 1500). Reported as warning; subsequently corrected by the monitoring worker.
   - **Non-existent changelog reference**: Registry hypothesis referenced `artifacts/v1_v2_changelog.md` that was never created. Reported as warning.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Stratified analysis credibility**: Discovered ALL R@1 values in stratified analysis are mock predictions (dry-run). This was a CRITICAL finding that changed the assessment from "strong evidence for Claim 2" to "tentative pending real model validation." Successfully escalated and adopted by worker team.
   - **Dataflow richness paradox**: Identified that rich-dataflow instances have lower R@1 than moderate. Through confound analysis, traced to pool_size (not repo_size) as the true confound. Rich instances have larger candidate pools (46-50 files vs 17-37), mechanically reducing R@1.
   - **analyze_stratified.py improvements**: Identified two issues (no batch encoding, wrong sim bins for real eval) that were subsequently fixed by worker. Verified fixes were correct.
   - **StarCoder process confusion**: Multiple train.py PIDs on cuda:1 initially appeared as duplicate training. Traced via ppid to confirm they were DataLoader workers from a single training process — NOT a resource conflict.
   - **Disk monitoring**: Tracked from 112GB→98GB free, confirmed healthy for ongoing operations.

6. All User Messages:
   - "Continue from where you left off." (×7): Auto-continuation signals after no-response-needed situations
   - "[worker_done: worker_analysis_plan_005_stratified_v2_20260514T202757]": Review request for stratified v2 analysis
   - "[worker_done: worker_analysis_dataflow_reposize_confound_20260514T203328]": Review request for confound analysis
   - "[worker_done: worker_analysis_plan_005_v1v2_diff_20260514T203611]": Review request for v1/v2 diff analysis
   - "[worker_done: worker_check_m2_progress_20260514_v3_20260514T204214]": Review request for M2 progress check
   - "[worker_done: worker_code_plan_005_real_eval_script_20260514T204618]": Review request for real eval script code
   - "[worker_done: worker_fix_plan_005_batch_encoding_and_sim_bins_20260514T205608]": Review request for batch encoding + sim bins fix
   - "[worker_done: worker_check_m1_reextract_v2_progress_20260514T210517]": Review request for M1 reextract progress
   - "[worker_done: worker_monitor_progress_check_may15_20260514T211439]": Review request for comprehensive progress check
   - "[worker_done: worker_research_related-work-expansion_20260514T211428]": Review request for related work expansion

        summary: "用 AST path 学习代码向量表示，首次大规模证明结构信息对代码表示学习的价值。"

      - title: "code2seq: Generating Sequences from Structured Representations of Code"
        authors: "Uri Alon, Shaked Brody, Omer Levy, Eran Yahav"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "code2vec 的序列生成扩展，用 AST path attention 生成方法名摘要。"

      - title: "Detecting Code Clones with Graph Neural Network and Flow-Augmented Abstract Syntax Tree"
        authors: "Wenhan Wang, Ge Li, Bo Ma, Xin Xia, Zhi Jin"
        venue: SANER
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "FA-AST: 用 data-flow 增强 AST 进行代码克隆检测，与 StructFuse 用 data-flow 做 hard negative 挖掘思路相关。"

      - title: "GraphCodeBERT: Pre-training Code Representations with Data Flow"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Shuo Ren, Shuai Lu, Zhangyin Feng, Duyu Tang, Shujie Liu, Long Zhou, Nan Duan, Alexey Svyatkovskiy, Shengyu Fu, Michele Tufano, Shao Kun Deng, Colin Clement, Dawn Drain, Neel Sundaresan, Jian Yin, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "在预训练中引入 data-flow edge，证明 data-flow 信息提升代码理解任务。StructFuse 的 insight 与此相关但用途不同（hard negative mining vs pre-training）。"

      - title: "ARISE: A Repository-level Graph Representation and Toolset for Agentic Fault Localization and Program Repair"
        authors: "Shahd Seddik, Fatemeh Fard"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "用 multi-granularity program graph（含 intra-procedural def-use edges）辅助 LLM agent 做 fault localization。仅 intra-procedural + runtime tool calls，与 StructFuse 的 inter-procedural static mining 互补。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 5: Code Embeddings / Code Search
  # ==========================================================================
  code_embeddings_search:
    description: "代码嵌入模型和代码搜索方法"
    papers:

      - title: "CodeSearchNet Challenge: Evaluating the State of Semantic Code Search"
        authors: "Hamel Husain, Ho-Hsiang Wu, Tiferet Gazit, Miltiadis Allamanis, Marc Brockschmidt"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "代码语义搜索 benchmark 和数据集，推动了代码嵌入模型的发展。"

      - title: "CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages"
        authors: "Zhangyin Feng, Daya Guo, Duyu Tang, Nan Duan, Xiaocheng Feng, Ming Gong, Lixin Zou, Bing Qin, Ting Liu, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou"
        venue: "EMNLP (Findings)"
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "首个编程语言-自然语言双模态预训练模型，代码嵌入的早期里程碑。"

      - title: "UniXcoder: Unified Cross-Modal Pre-training for Code Representation"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Shuai Lu, Nan Duan, Yanlin Wang, Ming Zhou, Jian Yin"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "统一跨模态代码预训练，在代码搜索等任务上取得 SOTA。"

      - title: "StarCoder: May the Source Be with You!"
        authors: "Raymond Li, Loubna Ben Allal, et al. (BigCode)"
        venue: TMLR
        year: 2023
        relation: building-block
        summary: "大规模开源代码 LLM，StructFuse 用 StarCoder2-3B 作为对比学习检索器的 backbone 之一。"

      - title: "Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code"
        authors: "Baptiste Roziere, Jonas Gehring, Fabian Gloeckle, et al. (Meta AI)"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2023
        relation: background
        summary: "Meta 的代码大模型系列，基于 Llama 2 微调。"

      - title: "Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report"
        authors: "Binyuan Hui, Jian Yang, Zeyu Cui, et al. (Qwen Team, Alibaba)"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: building-block
        summary: "Qwen 代码模型系列，StructFuse 用 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 作为对比学习检索器的 backbone。"

      - title: "DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Qihao Zhu, Dejian Yang, Zhenda Xie, Kai Dong, Wentao Zhang, Guanting Chen, Xiao Bi, Yu Wu, Y.K. Li, Fuli Luo, Yingfei Xiong, Wenfeng Liang"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: background
        summary: "开源代码 LLM 系列 (1.3B-33B)，project-level 代码训练 + 16K context + fill-in-the-blank 预训练。"

      - title: "RepoFusion: Training Code Models to Understand Your Repository"
        authors: "Disha Shrivastava, Denis Kocetkov, Harm de Vries, Dzmitry Bahdanau, Torsten Scholak"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2023
        relation: background
        summary: "训练代码模型融合多个 cross-file repo context 进行代码补全，小模型 + repo context 可匹配大模型性能。"

      - title: "BM25"
        authors: "Stephen Robertson, Hugo Zaragoza"
        venue: "Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval"
        year: 2009
        relation: baseline
        summary: "经典稀疏检索方法，StructFuse 的 baseline 之一。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 6: Graph-Guided Code Navigation (Inference-Time)
  # ==========================================================================
  graph_guided_inference:
    description: "推理时利用代码结构图辅助导航/检索的方法（与 StructFuse 的训练时结构信号互补）"
    papers:

      - title: "LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization"
        authors: "Zhaoling Chen, Robert Tang, Gangda Deng, Fang Wu, Jialong Wu, Zhiwei Jiang, Viktor Prasanna, Arman Cohan, Xingyao Wang"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "将代码库解析为有向异构图，LLM agent 通过 multi-hop 推理在图上导航做代码定位。推理时用结构图，StructFuse 训练时用。"

      - title: "CodexGraph: Bridging Large Language Models and Code Repositories via Code Graph Databases"
        authors: "Xiangyan Liu, Bo Lan, Zhiyuan Hu, Yang Liu, Zhicheng Zhang, Fei Wang, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Wenmeng Zhou"
        venue: NAACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "将代码库索引到图数据库，LLM agent 通过 graph query 接口检索结构化上下文。"

      - title: "RANGER: Repository-Level Agent for Graph-Enhanced Retrieval"
        authors: "Pratik Shah, Rajat Ghosh, Aryan Singhal, Debojyoti Dutta"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 repo 知识图（含 variable-level 节点），dual-stage retrieval: Cypher lookup + MCTS-guided graph exploration。"

  # ==========================================================================
  infrastructure:

        venue: "IEEE Transactions on Big Data"
        year: 2021
        relation: building-block
        summary: "FAISS: GPU 加速的大规模向量相似度搜索库，StructFuse 用于 ANN-based hard negative mining。"

        authors: "Max Brunsfeld et al."
        venue: "Software (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.13375512)"
        year: 2018
